author: Home Repair Tutor
description: How to bevel and polish porcelain tile…I’m using porcelain for the shower bench top. I make the dimensions 1/2 inch bigger. Then I bevel the tile with my grinder/diamond blade and polish it with electroplated pads. I highly recommend wearing the Ironclad Command A9 gloves because of the high cut resistance and polyurethane grip. Gotta keep your hands safe in order ro remain on the job 💯🔥#handsafety #bathroomremodel #homerenovation #sponsored
